verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack that Microsoft Authenticator supports Steam Guard codes, HOTP counters, or custom periods/digit lengths; the documentation only covers standard push/OTP flows for Microsoft and generic accounts. Community evidence (comm-6) even indicates MS Authenticator issues non-standard QR codes incompatible with other TOTP clients, suggesting a closed, non-extensible token model rather than support for advanced/non-standard formats.
